BulletFocusSettings.description:
Optional GSAP key-driven focus parameters for list items.

When a slide enables ``bullet_focus``, all list items start dimmed
except the first; pressing ``key`` advances the focused bullet so
that exactly one item is fully opaque while the others fade to
``dim``. Omitted fields inherit deck defaults, then skill defaults.

key.description: Keyboard key that advances the focused bullet (e.g. "j").
key.title: Key

back_key.description: Keyboard key that moves the focus to the previous bullet (e.g. "k").
back_key.title: Back Key

dim.description: Opacity applied to non-focused list items.
dim.title: Dim

duration.description: Tween duration in seconds for opacity transitions.
duration.title: Duration

BulletFocusSettings.title: BulletFocusSettings

threshold.description: IntersectionObserver threshold for starting the animation.

DeckMetadata.description:
Deck-level metadata from the first frontmatter block.

Attributes:
    flavor: If ``'transcript'``, HTML uses dense left-aligned styling for
        ``content`` and ``table`` slides (transcript / transcribe_to_html).
        Omitted for standard presentation decks.

math_display_scale.description: Multiplier for $$...$$ display math font size vs slide body.
math_display_scale.title: Math Display Scale

math_display_center.description: If True, display math is centered; if False, aligned with body text.
math_display_center.title: Math Display Center

math_display_color.description: Optional CSS color for $$...$$ (display / block) math in slide bodies and tables.
math_display_color.title: Math Display Color

view_scale.description: Default in-page view scale for slide content (not the browser tab zoom).
view_scale.title: View Scale

remember_view_scale.description: If True, persist view-scale adjustments in localStorage.
remember_view_scale.title: Remember View Scale

autofit_floor.description: Smallest zoom autofit applies to a slide's content area. Below it the content scrolls and the slide is reported as needing a split.
autofit_floor.title: Autofit Floor

autofit_widen_max.description: Cap on how much wider (x canvas width) the content area may become while shrinking, so lines stay readable. 1.0 = never widen (tables then cannot fit).
autofit_widen_max.title: Autofit Widen Max

autofit_title_floor.description: Smallest zoom autofit applies to a title that does not fit one line. A title that still does not fit takes two lines at full size.
autofit_title_floor.title: Autofit Title Floor

bake_mermaid.description: If True, pre-render Mermaid diagrams to inline SVG at compile time (requires mmdc); makes the deck offline and cross-browser deterministic.
bake_mermaid.title: Bake Mermaid

title_scale.description: Multiplier for slide titles, heading stacks, and hero text (combined with --font-scale).
title_scale.title: Title Scale

content_scale.description: Multiplier for body, captions, tables, code, and non-title prose (combined with --font-scale).
content_scale.title: Content Scale

blockquote_scale.description: Multiplier for `>` blockquotes on top of content_scale (a blockquote is 44px against 28px body, so 0.64 makes it body-sized).
blockquote_scale.title: Blockquote Scale

figure_scale.description: Default scale for layout: figure and figure-wide — multiplies the width cap and matching max-height (vh) so media scales proportionally; the figure panel uses width: fit-content up to the cap.
figure_scale.title: Figure Scale

figure_layout_debug.description: If True, draw red debug borders on layout: figure .figure-asset-wrap (panel) and inner graphic (img / .diagram-container).
figure_layout_debug.title: Figure Layout Debug

footer_scale.description: Multiplies the fixed bottom bar (page counter, view-scale, go-to) font sizes and padding; set on the root as CSS --footer-scale.
footer_scale.title: Footer Scale

footer_inset.description: CSS length for the fixed footer nav distance from the viewport bottom (e.g. 0.5in — half a inch margin above the screen edge; default 0.5in was 1in).
footer_inset.title: Footer Inset

animation_defaults.description: Deck-wide animation defaults; merged with skill defaults, then per-slide bullet_animation overrides.

gsap_script_url.description: HTTPS URL for the GSAP script tag. When omitted, the md_to_yaml skill default CDN URL is used.
gsap_script_url.title: Gsap Script Url
